Class LibrarySystem

java.lang.Object
library.service.LibrarySystem
public class LibrarySystem extends Object
Wires all services together and connects them to the DataStore. On first run (no data files) it seeds sample data: books in several categories, sample members and one overdue loan for demonstrating overdue tracking. A LibrarySystem created without a data folder works purely in memory (used by tests).
Author:
Usman
